Welcome to Orakzai Veterinary Center! 🐾
Orakzai Veterinary Center is your trusted hub for practical, reliable, and easy-to-understand information on veterinary care, especially focused on domestic animals, livestock management, and poultry diseases.

🔬 What We Cover on This Channel:
• Domestic & Livestock Animal Care
Learn essential tips for keeping cattle, goats, sheep, buffaloes, and poultry healthy. From nutrition and management to identifying behavioral changes, we guide you every step of the way.
• Poultry Health & Disease Management
Deep-dive into prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of common poultry diseases. 
• Veterinary Medicine & Practical Knowledge
Get insights into veterinary practices, medicines, vaccinations, dosing, and emerging trends.
• Animal Disease Prevention
Understand how to implement biosecurity.
